phase.name: Repository setup, rules and preview dashboard

steps.title: Branch and phase plan
steps.summary: Created branch phase-00-setup from main; plan posted in chat and written to docs/preview/status.json.

steps.title: Notion Build Log
steps.summary: Created the Build Log page, Start here page and all six databases (Prompts, Phases, Execution log, Decisions, Risks and findings, Test runs) under the private 'Studge Pass' page. Saved IDs in docs/notion.json. Archived the founder's task message, the full 00-master-setup.md (verified word-for-word by SHA-256) and the continuation message in Prompts. Created the Phase 0 row (In progress) and the step-1 execution log row.

steps.title: GitHub metadata
steps.summary: Created the 10 labels (phase, security, severity:*, follow-up, design, docs, ci), 17 milestones (one per phase, #1-#17) and 17 tracking issues (#6-#22, Phase 0 = #6). Notion Phases database now has one row per phase, each linked to its issue.

steps.title: Repo scaffold
steps.summary: GPL-3.0-or-later LICENSE (canonical text), relay/LICENSE (AGPL-3.0-or-later, canonical), README extended with status and build steps, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md (DCO, no CLA), .gitignore, .editorconfig, rust-toolchain.toml, rustfmt.toml, deny.toml (licence allowlist, yanked deny, openssl ban), docs skeletons (SPEC, THREAT_MODEL, PROGRESS, DECISIONS), placeholder READMEs for desktop/extension/android/ios.

steps.title: Starter crates
steps.summary: Cargo workspace with five crates: studge-core (forbid unsafe, seven empty modules), studge-core-wasm (cdylib + rlib, version() via wasm-bindgen, forbid unsafe), studge-relay (axum + tokio, GET /health on 127.0.0.1:8787 returning {status, version}, unit test), studge CLI (clap --version, unit test), studge-test-harness (empty lib). Cargo.lock committed. Build 21.6s, fmt/clippy/test/wasm/deny all green.

steps.title: CI workflows
steps.summary: ci.yml (fmt, clippy, test, wasm build on ubuntu+windows; cargo deny on ubuntu; actions pinned to full commit SHAs; contents: read), security.yml (gitleaks on every push/PR, cargo-audit weekly), codeql.yml (JS/TS + Rust), dependabot.yml (cargo, npm, github-actions weekly). All four files validated as YAML.

steps.title: Full check suite
steps.summary: Full suite via .\x.ps1 all green: fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, test --all (2 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored), cargo deny (advisories/bans/licenses/sources ok), wasm32 build. Live checks: studge --version prints 'studge 0.1.0'; relay answers GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/health with {"status":"ok","version":"0.1.0"} from Windows.

steps.title: Preview dashboard
steps.summary: pnpm workspace + tools/preview (Vite 8 + TypeScript, no framework, no runtime network requests): status.schema.json, strict validation on build, light/dark page with progress bar, checklist, check chips, commit timeline, screenshot gallery with lightbox, try-it cards with copy buttons and a risks table. pnpm preview / preview:update / shot / build all work; lint (tsc + eslint) and 19 Vitest tests pass.

steps.title: Dashboard screenshots
steps.summary: Serve the dashboard at http://localhost:4400, capture light and dark screenshots (desktop 1440 px and narrow 390 px) into docs/screenshots/phase-00/, add to the gallery, self-critique against the design bar.

steps.title: Self-attack review
steps.summary: List at least 10 concrete ways an attacker could break Phase 0's work; block each with a test where possible; record the rest as open risks in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md, Notion and GitHub security issues.

steps.title: Progress and logs
steps.summary: Phase 0 entry in docs/PROGRESS.md (what changed, how to run, test results, known gaps), Notion phase summary and test-run row, phase status In review.

steps.title: Final PR
steps.summary: gh pr create --base main (Closes #<phase-0 issue>, requests review from @lnstudge, links Notion summary), comment on the phase issue, post the final preview summary with file tree, verify commands and open questions. No merge.

commits.message: chore(preview): add Phase 0 plan and status checklist
chore(notion): create Build Log with six databases and back-fill Phase 0 log
chore(github): record phase issue links in preview status
chore(repo): add licences, project docs and toolchain configuration
feat(workspace): scaffold core, core-wasm, relay, cli and test-harness
ci: add workflows, secret scanning, CodeQL and dependabot
fix(ci): pass the toolchain input explicitly to dtolnay/rust-toolchain
docs(preview): record full check suite results and try-it commands

try_it.label: Relay health endpoint
try_it.command_or_url: .\x.ps1 cargo run -p studge-relay   then open http://127.0.0.1:8787/health

try_it.label: Golden path checks
try_it.command_or_url: .\x.ps1 "cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --all && cargo deny check"
